name: Coopers Rock State Forest
unique: A sandstone overlook above the Cheat River gorge with a cliff edge view, plus miles of trails, climbing and a CCC picnic shelter.
buzz: The overlook is the photograph and the underlook trail is the adventure; the forest is busy in fall and the cliffs are for experienced climbers.

name: Core Arboretum
unique: Ninety one acres of old growth forest on the Monongahela river bluff with a trail system and a spring wildflower display, free on the university campus.
buzz: The spring wildflowers and the old trees are the reason naturalists come and it is free; the trails are steep in places.

name: West Virginia Botanic Garden
unique: A garden on a former reservoir site with a wetland boardwalk, a children's garden and trails through woods, free to the public.
buzz: The boardwalk and the children's garden are the family stops and it is free; the garden is young and growing.

name: Berkeley Springs State Park
unique: A warm spring bathhouse in the middle of a small town, used since before the Revolution, with private baths and a Roman bath house.
buzz: The baths are the reason to come and the town is full of spas and shops; George Washington bathed here and the water is still free at the fountain.

name: Cacapon Resort State Park
unique: Six thousand acres on Cacapon Mountain with a lodge, a lake, horseback trails and a ridge trail to a view of three states.
buzz: The ridge trail and the lake are the reasons to come and the lodge is a good base; the park is quiet compared with the gorge.

name: Durbin and Greenbrier Valley Railroad
unique: Heritage trains from Elkins into the Monongahela high country, with a dinner train, a wilderness train and a climb to the High Falls of the Cheat.
buzz: The wilderness train and the fall color are the reasons to book and the dinner train is the date night; seats go early in October.

name: Mountain State Forest Festival
unique: A festival of the state's timber heritage with lumberjack competitions, a parade, a queen and a sawdust pile for children, in the heart of the Monongahela forest.
buzz: The lumberjack contests are the draw and the parade is the tradition; it is a real county fair atmosphere with no tourists.

name: Blennerhassett Island
unique: A island in the Ohio River reached by sternwheeler, with a reconstruction of the mansion Aaron Burr visited and a horse drawn wagon tour.
buzz: The sternwheeler ride and the mansion are the reasons to go and the island is flat and shaded; the tour runs on a schedule.

name: Oil and Gas Museum
unique: A museum of the oil and gas boom that started in this valley, with drilling tools, a model derrick and the stories of the wildcatters.
buzz: The tools and the photographs are the reason to stop; it is small and the volunteers know the local wells.

name: West Virginia Independence Hall
company: West Virginia Division of Culture and History
unique: The custom house where the Restored Government of Virginia met and the debate over West Virginia statehood happened, with the original courtroom and chambers.
buzz: The room where statehood was argued is the reason to come and it is free; the building is a cast iron fronted landmark in downtown Wheeling.

name: Pricketts Fort
unique: A reconstructed palisade fort and cabins on the Monongahela, with interpreters in period dress and a 1770s job of work going on.
buzz: The fort and the demonstrations are the family draw and the site is on the river; the living history weekends bring it alive.

name: Summersville Lake
unique: The clearest lake in the state, with sandstone cliffs rising from the water that are a eastern climbing destination and a beach at the state park.
buzz: Climbers come for the overhanging sandstone and families come for the swim; the lake is deep and the cliffs are for experienced climbers only.
